description: Print specs for Bottle Your Brand custom labels and stickers — wine, beer, wrap-around water bottle, dropper bottle, and all-purpose square (2x2 to 5x5) and rectangle (3x2, 4x2, 4x3, 6x4) stickers: trim size, bleed, safe zone, ideal pixel size, and the exact size or aspect ratio to request from ChatGPT or Gemini image generation so the artwork fits the label with minimal cropping, plus a downloadable PDF design template (canvas with bleed and the red cut line) for customers designing in Canva, Photoshop or Illustrator. Use it before generating or designing label artwork, and follow artwork_rules in the image prompt.

product.description: Product: wine, beer, water (wrap-around water bottle label), dropper, square-sticker or rectangle-sticker (all-purpose square/rectangle stickers and labels for jars, boxes, bags, candles, etc.).

size.description: Size in inches, WxH. Defaults to the most popular. wine: 3.5x4; beer: 4x3.5; water: 8.25x1.75 or 8x2.125; dropper: 3x2; square-sticker: 3x3 or 2x2 or 4x4 or 5x5; rectangle-sticker: 3x2 or 4x2 or 4x3 or 6x4
